dict.string: Family IT uses Apple events to send messages and create notes when you request those actions.
Family IT looks up people you name so it can send your requested messages. Your address book stays on this Mac.
Family IT uses Location permission only to read the connected Wi-Fi network name locally when you ask it to check your connection. Your location is not requested or saved.
Family IT checks the connected Wi-Fi network name locally. It does not request or save your coordinates.
Family IT uses the microphone while you choose to talk so it can hear the technology problem you describe. Audio recordings are not saved.
Family IT turns your spoken words into text so it can guide you through technology problems one step at a time.
